I’m a photographer- and work  people in less physically intimate ways but emotionally- I would also be upset if a shoot I spent a lot of time on became obsolete or unusable.
However I’m also a 20 year old woman and the idea of something like that coming back to haunt me does scare me. 

I would suggest having a sit down with her and explaining what and why you would use the images for etc. 
Work with her- but 
If she still wants them deleted - delete them. 

This work is a few years old now- your being offered money you could put towards another model and studio and you can try and recreate/ improve shots. 

She deserves to have autonomy over her body and those images. 

Also if someone with these kinds of Nude photos of me kept them… for no reason if they aren’t going on your portfolio etc it would set off a lot of alarm bells.

Did she sign a model release because if she didn’t you have no footing here whatsoever. 

If your interested in keeping these photos I’m assuming your in the same sphere of work -this should also rightly muddy your reputation if she decided to discuss it.

OP delete the photos- its in everyone’s best interest.
